def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    sep_rows=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r]))==1 and all(v==grid[r][0] for v in grid[r])]
    sep_cols=[c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1]
    # Keep only uniform lines whose color differs from the common background.
    vals=[v for row in grid for v in row]
    bg=max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
    sep_rows=[r for r in sep_rows if grid[r][0]!=bg]
    sep_cols=[c for c in sep_cols if grid[0][c]!=bg]
    rb=[-1]+sep_rows+[h]; cb=[-1]+sep_cols+[w]
    rsegs=[(rb[i]+1,rb[i+1]) for i in range(len(rb)-1)]
    csegs=[(cb[i]+1,cb[i+1]) for i in range(len(cb)-1)]
    tiles=[(r0,r1,c0,c1) for r0,r1 in rsegs for c0,c1 in csegs]
    source=None
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in tiles:
        if any(grid[r][c]!=bg for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)):
            source=(r0,r1,c0,c1); break
    if source is None: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=source
    pattern=[[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1)] for r in range(r0,r1)]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for a,b,x,y in tiles:
        if b-a==len(pattern) and y-x==len(pattern[0]):
            for i in range(b-a):
                for j in range(y-x): out[a+i][x+j]=pattern[i][j]
    return out

source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    values = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    background = max(set(values), key=values.count)
    sep_rows = [r for r in sep_rows if grid[r][0] != background]
    sep_cols = [c for c in sep_cols if grid[0][c] != background]

    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_segments = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1])
                    for i in range(len(row_bounds) - 1)]
    col_segments = [(col_bounds[i] + 1, col_bounds[i + 1])
                    for i in range(len(col_bounds) - 1)]
    tiles = [(r0, r1, c0, c1)
             for r0, r1 in row_segments for c0, c1 in col_segments]

    source = None
    for r0, r1, c0, c1 in tiles:
        if any(grid[r][c] != background
               for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)):
            source = (r0, r1, c0, c1)
            break
    if source is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    r0, r1, c0, c1 = source
    pattern = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for a, b, x, y in tiles:
        if b - a == len(pattern) and y - x == len(pattern[0]):
            for i in range(b - a):
                for j in range(y - x):
                    out[a + i][x + j] = pattern[i][j]
    return out
'''
